tasks.title: Add fixture missions for reset verification
tasks.notes: Create one real optimize mission fixture for XTUI verification and synthetic fixtures for targeted automated tests.

tasks.title: Add failing tests that prove reset is currently missing
validation: echo 'Targeted mission runner tests fail before implementation for converged and blocked resume cases'
tasks.notes: Use real mission history files and assert that resume currently halts before any new iteration after convergence or blocked stop.

tasks.title: Teach mission history parsing and runner logic about control resume-reset barriers
validation: echo 'Targeted mission history and runner tests pass with control barrier semantics'
tasks.notes: Control events must not count as experiments and must remain append-only.

tasks.title: Add /mission-reset command wiring and user-facing messages
validation: echo 'Slash command tests pass for success and rejection cases'
tasks.notes: Require an explicit path and reject build-mode missions clearly.

tasks.title: Add and run XTUI verification against a real fixture mission
validation: echo 'XTUI session shows /mission-reset success and fixture EXPERIMENTS.jsonl contains control/resume-reset event'
tasks.notes: Use a controlled workspace and assert on both terminal output and appended mission history.

tasks.title: Mark the mission complete once automated and XTUI verification are green
validation:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('devdocs/missions/mission-reset-control-event/TASKS.json')
data = json.loads(path.read_text())
assert all(task['status'] == 'done' for task in data['tasks'])
PY
tasks.notes: Only do this after the implementation exists, tests pass, and PROGRESS.md says the mission is complete.
